anchors.spacing.description: honeycomb anchor spacing, centre to centre, field units; must be at least tile.size + tile.minGap + 2 * anchors.maxOffset

anchors.maxOffset.description: largest distance a letter's wave, bob and spring offset together may take it from its anchor, field units

anchors.bodyRoom.description: gap between the anchor lattice and the field walls that the sway and the gust may move the whole lattice into, field units

anchors.spare.description: free anchors the lattice keeps beyond the round's letters and decoys, for hops, volleys and refills

anchors.clearX.description: x of the centre of Babel's porthole in field units (mirrors babel.cornerX and the field layout), kept clear of anchors

anchors.clearY.description: y of the centre of Babel's porthole in field units (mirrors babel.cornerY and the field layout), kept clear of anchors

anchors.clearRadius.description: radius around the porthole centre (porthole plus name tag) that no anchored letter may reach, field units

anchors.swayX.description: whole-field sway amplitude, x, field units

anchors.swayY.description: whole-field sway amplitude, y, field units

anchors.swayHz.description: whole-field sway cycles per second at drift.speed = anchors.speedRef

anchors.waveAmp.description: amplitude of the wave rolling through the anchors, field units (at most anchors.maxOffset)

anchors.waveHz.description: wave cycles per second at drift.speed = anchors.speedRef

anchors.waveLen.description: wavelength of the rolling wave, field units

anchors.spring.description: stiffness of the offset spring (per second squared)

anchors.damping.description: damping of the offset spring (per second)

anchors.speedRef.description: drift.speed at which sway, wave and hop rate run at 1x

hop.arcPx.description: view only: how far a hopping letter lifts at mid-flight, in design px

hop.ringPx.description: view only: radius the landing ripple ring grows to, in design px

hop.ringSec.description: view only: seconds the landing ripple ring takes

tile.flinchSquash.description: view only: squash of the letter nearest a missed shot, share of its size

tether.comboWarm.description: view only: how far the tether colour shifts toward coral at max combo; 0 turns it off

hop.every.description: mean seconds between hops at drift.speed = anchors.speedRef; 0 turns hops off

hop.jitter.description: seconds added or removed at random from hop.every

hop.firstAt.description: round second of the first hop

hop.windSec.description: wind-up (tell) before a hop takes off, seconds

hop.flySec.description: flight time of a hop, seconds

hop.fromLevel.description: first Act I level order with hops (Act II and later always have them)

tether.travelTime.description: seconds for the tether to reach a tile at mid range

tether.travelMinMul.description: travel time multiplier at zero distance

tether.travelDistMul.description: extra travel time multiplier at a full field height of distance

tether.hitTolerance.description: field units: how far a tile may drift during travel and still be caught

tap.marginPx.description: screen px (1080 base) added to a tile's drawn radius for hit testing

tap.driftMarginMul.description: Drift mode multiplier on the tap radius

drift.speed.description: field units per second, before per-tile variation

spawner.decoys.description: decoys on the board in round 1

spawner.maxCopies.description: most copies of one letter a plain decoy may bring the field to (needed letters, counterfeits and trap letters are not capped); 0 turns the cap off

spawner.decoyRatio.description: decoys kept per real catchable letter on the board; the floor is spawner.decoys

spawner.decoyBonus.description: decoys added after spawner.decoyRatio and the ramp.decoyMax cap (never below 0 decoys); Pip's Sharp eye perk sets -1

spawner.refill.description: 1: the letters on the field stay as many as the two words' letters plus their decoys, so a caught letter is replaced (by a decoy on its own spot); 0: decoys follow the real letters left and the field thins out

spawner.refillDelay.description: seconds after a right catch before the replacement letter appears on the caught letter's spot (0: at once)

spawner.frontShare.description: share of catchable tiles on the front plane (1: the mid plane is retired, anchored drift)

ramp.driftStep.description: drift speed gain per round after the first

ramp.decoyStep.description: extra decoys per round after the first

babel.showSeconds.description: seconds a Babel line stays on screen

babel.throwSec.description: seconds one thrown tile takes to land (also the reduced-motion fade)

babel.throwOvershoot.description: back-ease overshoot of a thrown tile

babel.enterSec.description: seconds Babel takes to fly in from the top right to his perch (also the reduced-motion fade)

babel.quoteSec.description: seconds his line stays up after it has finished typing, before the letters are thrown

babel.exitSec.description: seconds Babel takes to fly back out top right (also the reduced-motion fade)

babel.perchX.description: perch x as a share of screen width (the sprite centre)

babel.perchY.description: perch y of the sprite centre as a share of screen height (owner, 16 Oct 2026: he comes in at the middle of the screen)

babel.heightShare.description: Babel sprite height as a share of screen width

babel.bobPx.description: hover bob amplitude in screen px

babel.swayAmp.description: cape and lower-body sway, as a UV share of the sprite width

babel.recoilPx.description: screen px Babel kicks back from each shot

field.width.description: field width in field units; the view fits width x (height - topMargin) to the screen with one scale, so 1.33 spans a 1080x1920 screen edge to edge

field.topMargin.description: field units reserved at the top for the HUD

tile.minGap.description: minimum clear gap in field units between catchable (plane 0 and 1) tiles

tile.glyphScale.description: letter glyph font size as a share of the tile size (owner, 13 Oct 2026: letters a little bigger)

tile.glyphOutlineNormal.description: ink halo width of a tile letter as a share of the tile size

tile.glyphOutline.description: the same halo with the High contrast letters setting on (WP-F.9); fully opaque ink

tile.size.description: tile edge in field units on the front plane

plane.frontScale.description: draw and hit scale of the front plane

plane.midScale.description: draw and hit scale of the mid plane

plane.backScale.description: draw scale of the back plane (background, not catchable)

plane.backSpeedMul.description: drift speed multiplier for back-plane tiles (parallax)

plane.midDim.description: how much darker mid-plane letters draw, so they read as one layer back

tile.bounceSquash.description: how far a bubble flattens when it bounces (fraction of its size)

tile.leanDeg.description: degrees a letter leans into its sideways motion

tile.pulse.description: bubble letters: share of size the breathing pulse adds and removes (owner: extremely subtle)

tile.pulseHz.description: bubble letters: breathing pulse cycles per second

tile.shadowOffset.description: screen px drop-shadow offset on the front plane

babel.settleSec.description: seconds over which the letters ease from still (after Babel's throw) to their full drift, so they do not all start moving at once

tile.spawnInSec.description: seconds a letter made mid-play takes to grow and fade in (reduced motion: fade only)

glass.blur.description: glass tile: sky blur strength, 0..1 (mip level scale)

glass.refractPx.description: glass tile: edge refraction in screen px

glass.frost.description: glass tile: dark frost alpha behind the glyph

glass.chroma.description: glass tile: colour fringe at the bevel (red and blue split)

glass.bubbleScale.description: bubble look: ball size relative to the tile (the letter keeps its size; visual only, the catch radius is unchanged)

glass.milk.description: glass tile: faint milky lift of the clear glass

glass.live.description: bubble look: 1 refracts the live screen (planets show magnified through the glass), 0 falls back to the baked sky

glass.magnify.description: bubble look: lens magnification at the centre of the bubble (0.12 = 12 % bigger)

glass.rimBend.description: bubble look: extra magnification toward the rim, where the glass bends most

glass.dark.description: bubble look: how far the inside of a bubble darkens toward night navy (owner mock v3: dark glossy bubbles)

glass.film.description: bubble look: strength of the iridescent soap-film rim

glass.filmSat.description: bubble look: how saturated the soap-film rim's rainbow is (0 pastel white, 1 full rainbow)

glass.filmWidth.description: bubble look: width of the soap-film rim in tile texture px (128 across)

glass.gloss.description: bubble look: strength of the white highlight crescent and dot at the top-left

glass.grain.description: glass tile: fine grain on the glass

glass.edgeTint.description: glass tile: rim and bottom accent tint strength

hud.hintAlpha.description: alpha of the ghost letter shown in an unfilled word slot by the Hint setting

fx.flyToSlotSec.description: seconds for a caught tile to fly to its slot

fx.shakePx.description: screen pixels (1080 wide) the play field shakes when a word is restored; half for a wrong catch or a drone shot down

fx.shakeSec.description: seconds a shake takes to settle

fx.bannerSec.description: seconds the restored word stays across the field

fx.heartbeatSec.description: a heartbeat sounds once a second while the clock is below this many seconds

flow.clearSec.description: seconds the leftover letters take to drift out of the field when a level ends

flow.starSec.description: seconds one earned star takes to fly from the clock bar into the level card

flow.starGapSec.description: seconds between one star's flight and the next

flow.storyReadSec.description: seconds a story line stays before the next one, before adding reading time

flow.storyCps.description: reading speed for story lines (characters per second), added to flow.storyReadSec

flow.refillSec.description: seconds the clock bar takes to refill for the next level

music.crossfadeSec.description: seconds a music bed takes to cross-fade into the next

music.duckDb.description: how far the music dips during comms and pause, in decibels

music.bedDb.description: level of the looping music bed before the Music slider, in decibels

music.stingDb.description: level of a character's leitmotif sting, in decibels

sfx.volumeDb.description: volume of the placeholder sound effects, in decibels

fx.dissolveSec.description: seconds for a surplus tile to dissolve

burst.seconds.description: burst length in seconds; the clock a round starts with is this plus burst.perLetterSec per letter of its words

burst.perLetterSec.description: seconds added to the burst for every letter in the round's words, so longer levels get a longer clock (0 = flat burst)

burst.maxWrong.description: wrong catches (plain or forged) that lose the round, so tapping every letter cannot win; 0 means no limit

burst.hintCost.description: seconds lost when the player uses a hint

stars.threeShare.description: share of the starting clock left for three stars (0.3333 = 10 s of 30, 20 s of 60)

stars.twoShare.description: share of the starting clock left for two stars

thief.firstAt.description: seconds until the first Babel thief

thief.interval.description: seconds between thief spawns; 0 = no thieves

thief.speed.description: thief seek speed, field units per second

thief.fleeSpeed.description: speed of a thief carrying a letter, flying up

thief.stealCost.description: seconds lost when a thief escapes with a letter

thief.respawnDelay.description: seconds before a stolen letter respawns

coach.ringPx.description: radius of the coach ring in pixels

coach.ringWidthPx.description: stroke width of the coach ring

coach.pulseAmount.description: ring size swing as a share of its radius

coach.captionGapPx.description: gap between the ring and the caption

coach.afterCatchSec.description: seconds the fill-every-slot caption stays after the first catch

hazard.counterfeitRatio.description: share of the decoys that are counterfeits: forged copies of a needed letter (Babel forges fragments)

hazard.traps.description: 1: the decoys include the letters of one short Babel counter-word; 0: no anagram trap

hazard.trapWindowSec.description: two trap letters caught within this many seconds set the trap off

hazard.trapCost.description: seconds the clock loses when the trap goes off

hazard.stroop.description: 1: Babel jams the colour channel on a schedule (slot hints dark, colours lie)

hazard.stroopEverySec.description: seconds between the starts of two jams

hazard.stroopSec.description: seconds a jam lasts (keep it under stroopEverySec)

hazard.shimmerSec.description: seconds one periwinkle shimmer sweep takes round a counterfeit bubble

perf.playFps.description: frame cap during play. Sits a little above 60 on purpose: Godot's web loop skips a browser frame that arrives before the target time, so a cap of exactly 60 on a 60 Hz screen can drop frames; 64 gives 60 on a 120 Hz screen and full rate on 60 Hz

perf.menuFps.description: frame cap on menus, the pause menu and other screens. Sits a little above 30 on purpose, for the same reason as perf.playFps

intro.holdSec.description: seconds the intro screen shows before it moves on to the title by itself; a tap anywhere skips it (WP-F.28)

drift.shyRadius.description: letters within this distance of a drone edge away from it, field units (0 = off)

drift.shyPush.description: speed of the shy push, field units per second at zero distance

drift.rippleRadius.description: a catch pushes letters within this distance outward, field units (0 = off)

drift.ripplePush.description: initial speed of the ripple push, field units per second

thief.sideShare.description: chance a drone enters from the left or right edge instead of the top (never from the bottom); Act I levels set 0 (WP-F.18)

thief.sideMaxY.description: side entries come in only within this share of the play area below field.topMargin

babel.cornerX.description: centre of Babel's corner porthole, share of view width (WP-F.18)

babel.cornerY.description: centre of Babel's corner porthole, share of view height

babel.cornerSize.description: diameter of Babel's corner porthole, share of view width

tile.breathe.description: idle scale pulse of a letter, share of its size (0 = off)

tile.breatheHz.description: idle scale pulse rate, cycles per second

tile.stretch.description: squash and stretch along the motion when a letter darts or is pushed, share of its size

babel.moveEvery.description: seconds between Babel's moves from his corner (0 = no moves) (WP-F.19)

babel.moveFirstAt.description: round seconds before Babel's first move

babel.tellSec.description: how long his porthole glows to warn of a move before it happens

babel.movesFromLevel.description: Act I level order from which Babel makes moves (earlier Act I levels have none)

babel.volleyDecoys.description: decoys a volley fires into the field

babel.gustFromAct.description: first act with the gust move (5 = never)

babel.gustSec.description: how long a gust pushes the letters

babel.gustPush.description: gust push speed, field units per second

babel.shieldFromAct.description: first act with the shield move (5 = never)

babel.shieldSec.description: how long a shield keeps one needed letter from being caught

babel.scrambleFromAct.description: first act with the scramble move (5 = never)

babel.scrambleSec.description: how long scrambled letters take to fly to their new places (not catchable meanwhile)

babel.volleyLifeSec.description: seconds a volley decoy stays before it dissolves, so volleys do not pile up (WP-F.19)
